role: A packed 4-bit array for per-block metadata, sky light, block light and the block-id high nibble in each ExtendedBlockStorage section, index y << 8 | z << 4 | x, two cells per byte.
scope_reason: Holds every section's metadata and light values.

members.name: data
members.note: Unpacked: struct chunk holds metas, sky and blocklight as one byte per cell in the flat x << 12 | z << 8 | y layout.

members.name: depthBits
members.note: Layout parameter; the C layout is fixed.

members.name: NibbleArray
members.note: Wrapping saved NBT bytes: the checkpoint loader unpacks Data, SkyLight, BlockLight and Add inline.

members.name: get
members.note: Low nibble for even index, high for odd (serverreplay.c 4703); direct byte reads elsewhere.

members.name: set
members.note: Direct byte stores, values kept in 0..15.

notes: The packing itself only matters at the NBT boundary (checkpoint load, snapshot I/O); I did not check snapshot.c's writers. Gates not re-run.
